whatIsGenerativeAI.question: What is generative AI?
whatIsGenerativeAI.answer: Generative artificial intelligence is a technology capable of creating original content, such as text, images or even code, from pre-existing data. It is used to automate tasks, improve creativity and optimize processes in various sectors of activity.

whoAreTrainings.question: Who are your training courses for?
whoAreTrainings.answer: Our training courses are aimed at all profiles: managers, employees, entrepreneurs, students and individuals. We adapt the content and pedagogy according to the level and specific needs of each participant.

howLongTraining.question: How long do your training courses last?
howLongTraining.answer: The duration varies depending on the type of training: from a few hours for awareness to several days for in-depth training. We also offer tailor-made support that can extend over several weeks.

trainingFormats.question: What training formats are offered?
trainingFormats.answer: We offer face-to-face, online (videoconference) and hybrid training. We adapt to your geographical and organizational constraints to offer you the best learning experience.

followUpAfterTraining.question: Is there follow-up after training?
followUpAfterTraining.answer: Yes, we offer post-training support to help you put into practice the knowledge acquired. This can include Q&A sessions, mentoring or technical support depending on your needs.

whyChooseMadinIA.question: Why choose Madin.IA?
whyChooseMadinIA.answer: Madin.IA combines technical expertise, adapted pedagogical approach and knowledge of the local market. We are based in Martinique and understand the specificities of Caribbean companies while having a global vision of generative AI.

reglementInterieur.titre: INTERNAL REGULATIONS OF THE TRAINING ORGANIZATION

articles.contenu: These internal regulations apply to all trainees participating in training provided by the training organization. By registering for training, each trainee agrees to comply with the rules and prescriptions defined below. These internal regulations are available on our website and provided in the candidate area. If the training takes place on the client company's premises, the client company's internal regulations apply for hygiene and safety rules. For all other clauses, the service provider organization's internal regulations apply.

The safety and health of trainees is a priority. Trainees must respect the hygiene and safety instructions in force in the training organization's premises. For in-person training, specific rules related to the health crisis (e.g., Covid-19) must be strictly respected:
articles.consignes_incendie: Fire safety instructions, including the location of fire extinguishers and emergency exits, must be taken into account upon arrival at the premises. In case of incident or accident, the trainee must immediately inform the training organization.

articles.contenu: It is forbidden to consume alcohol, drugs, or to smoke in the training premises. Any inappropriate behavior, whether verbal or physical, may result in disciplinary sanctions, ranging from a warning to permanent exclusion from the training.
Violations of the internal regulations may result in sanctions, such as:
types_sanctions: Temporary or permanent exclusion from training
articles.application: Sanctions are applied according to the severity of the offense. Fines or financial sanctions are prohibited.

articles.contenu: Trainees must adopt a respectful and professional attitude. Decent attire is required for all participants. Any form of harassment or disruptive behavior will result in sanctions.

Trainees must respect training schedules. Any delay or absence must be justified. Unjustified absences may result in sanctions and, for training funded by a third party (OPCO, Pôle emploi, etc.), salary deductions or information to their funder. In case of delay, the trainee must inform the trainer via the contact details available on the platform or website as soon as possible.

Trainees are required to sign the attendance sheet at each session. At the end of the training, a certificate of attendance and a certificate of completion will be issued to them. These documents must be transmitted to the employer or funder, if necessary. In the case of training covered by public or mutual funds, an individual completion certificate will be sent to each trainee.

The candidate is required to attend training with their computer equipment. Equipment provided for training must be used exclusively for this purpose. In case of malfunction, the trainee must immediately inform the trainer. Equipment must be kept in good condition.

Access to the premises is reserved for training. It is forbidden to bring persons foreign to the training organization without prior authorization. The sale of goods or services is also prohibited on the premises.
Audio or video recordings of training sessions are prohibited without prior authorization. Documentation provided during training is protected by copyright and may only be used for personal purposes.
The training organization declines all responsibility in case of loss, theft or damage to personal belongings of trainees left on the premises.

Information collected about trainees is used for administrative and financial follow-up of training. It is kept for 3 years. In accordance with European Regulation 2016/679 on data protection, trainees may access, rectify, or delete their data by contacting the training organization.
Training is accessible to all, including people with disabilities. Specific support can be provided upon request.

The internal regulations are given to each trainee before training. Signing the document is not required by law, but it may be requested to ensure that the trainee is informed of their rights and obligations.
These internal regulations are posted in the training organization's premises and can be consulted at any time.
